B_memory

bracket: A speed versus B memory: A, because bounded numeric lists are simpler than parallel count/first state.
A versus C readability: A, because C reorders existing control flow for no demonstrated gain.
A versus incumbent: incumbent holds; finditer is consistent across threshold forms and avoids an extra findall string list.
justification: The patch is confined to refusing unsupported fractional-percent tokens.
All three challengers matched exact values/reasons; none demonstrated a material readability or performance benefit.
Retaining existing control flow minimizes impact on validator and report-test callers.
